user_directed_request.summary: Adaptive Expert Computation / Compression を厚くするため、Merge Then Compressの被引用側からexpert pruning/compressionの強候補を追加する。

candidates.title: It Takes a MAESTRO To Prune Bad Experts
candidates.reason: Markov chainでcross-layer expert activation依存をモデル化するglobal structured pruning。

candidates.title: Less is MoE: Trimming Experts in Domain-Specialist Language Models
candidates.reason: expert単位ではなくFFN intermediate dimensionのFisher importanceで圧縮する中間粒度手法。

candidates.title: TENP: Trapezoidal Expert Neuron Pruning For Mixture-of-Experts

candidates.title: Pruning and Distilling Mixture-of-Experts into Dense Language Models
